verdict.rationale: A live llms.txt is confirmed at support.claude.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with structured topic listings, directly supporting an AI-native user pointing an agent at Claude's agent-oriented docs. However, per-page markdown doc access failed (404) and no OpenAPI/agent-doc schema was found, so the broader agent-doc ecosystem is only partially verified. Missing for 10: working per-page markdown docs, independent third-party confirmation of llms.txt usage by agents, and evidence of an OpenAPI or structured docs API.
